import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the cblas_cscal function
cblas_cscal = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so').cblas_cscal
cblas_cscal.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.c_int]
cblas_cscal.restype = None

# Function to scale a complex vector
def scale_complex_vector(N, alpha, X, incX):
    # Convert inputs to ctypes
    alpha_real = np.float32(alpha.real)
    alpha_imag = np.float32(alpha.imag)
    alpha_ctypes = (ctypes.c_float * 2)(alpha_real, alpha_imag)
    X_array = np.array(X, dtype=np.complex64)
    X_ctypes = X_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float))
    
    # Call the cblas_cscal function
    cblas_cscal(N, alpha_ctypes, X_ctypes, incX)
    
    # Convert the result back to a Python list
    return list(X_array)

# Test cases

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Scale a vector of complex numbers
    N = 3
    alpha = complex(2, 3)
    X = [complex(1, 1), complex(2, 2), complex(3, 3)]
    incX = 1
    expected_result = [complex(-1, 5), complex(-2, 10), complex(-3, 15)]
    result = scale_complex_vector(N, alpha, X, incX)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected_result), f"Test case 1 failed: {result}"

    # Test case 2: Scale a vector with increment
    N = 2
    alpha = complex(1, -1)
    X = [complex(1, 1), complex(2, 2), complex(3, 3), complex(4, 4)]
    incX = 2
    expected_result = [complex(2, 0), complex(2, 2), complex(6, 0), complex(4, 4)]
    result = scale_complex_vector(N, alpha, X, incX)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected_result), f"Test case 2 failed: {result}"

    # Test case 3: Edge case with zero elements
    N = 0
    alpha = complex(1, 1)
    X = []
    incX = 1
    expected_result = []
    result = scale_complex_vector(N, alpha, X, incX)
    assert result == expected_result, f"Test case 3 failed: {result}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
